{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Now'' what are you listening to?'' [...] ''I can see you nodding to the beat.''"<br />"''Want to listen in?''"<br />"''I'm psyched up enough, thanks.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Fi Skirata|Fi]]|<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BolesRoorGuitar-PodracingTales.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Boles Roor, putting on a glimmik concert]]
'''Glimmik''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] genre known for its loud, frenetic sound<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> and thumping beat.<ref name="TZ" /> Similar to [[Heavy Isotope]] in many ways, glimmik differentiated itself with a fitter, more extreme image, and featured inspirational lyrical content. By [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], glimmik had gained significant popularity throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], particularly among [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] and those who led high-energy lifestyles; many racers, daredevils, and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] favored glimmik music. Glimmik music was often played at [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] courts, and a number of [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxers]] used glimmik tracks as entrance music at venues across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Slugthrowers" />

[[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]], was a successful glimmik [[Musician/Legends|singer]]<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|bolesroor|Roor, Boles}}</ref> who regularly performed sold-out concerts at the [[Kallarak Amphitheater]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Coruscant">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Roor's superstar status was thought to be the cause of many [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] becoming fans of glimmik.<ref name="Slugthrowers" /> The night before competing in the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he gave a concert,<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref> and after losing the race, Roor retired from the sport of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] and went on a galactic singing tour.<ref name="RR">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>

The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata|RC-8015]]—known by the nickname Fi—was a lover of glimmik music. During his service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Fi would often listen to glimmik music at a loud volume within the confines of his [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|helmet's]] audio circuit to mentally prepare himself for an upcoming operation,<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> and developed a habit of nodding his head along with the thumping beat of the music. Though his pre-combat glimmik music ritual was not one his [[Omega Squad|squadmates]] shared, Fi listened to glimmik prior to a [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|TIOPS]] [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|mission]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection,<ref name="TZ" /> and both prior to and during a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] to the planet [[Gaftikar]].<ref name="TC" />
